question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Objection
solution: The correct answer is **"Disapproval."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Objection"** means expressing disapproval or dissent towards something. (आपत्ति, ऐतराज़; किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति नापसंदगी या विरोध का कारण) • **Example**: *We listed our **objections**__ to the proposed new road.* • **Disapproval** is a synonym of **objection.** • **"Disapproval" **means expressing negative feelings towards something. (अस्‍वीकृति (बुरा होने के कारण)) __ • **Example**: *She shook her head in **disapproval**__.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Moan"** means a long, low sound made in response to physical or emotional pain or suffering. (कराहट, क्रंदन) • **"Counter"** means opposing or responding to something with an argument or action. (आलोचना का जवाब देना; प्रतिक्रिया या विरोध करना) • **"Sanction"** means official permission or approval for an action or decision. (आधिकारिक अनुमति, मंज़ूरी, संस्‍वीकृति (किसी काम की)) 42:Tb8b, The correct answer is **"first."**
